We need to produce correct tool call format. Let's call search_template_catalog_by_criteria.

But we need a molecule SMILES. Could use one of the precursors? Actually the target molecule is the product of HWE, which likely is the alkene with carboxylic acid. The precursors list includes three SMILES that look like product? Let's examine first: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO". This is a complex molecule with sugar ring and a side chain with conjugated diene and carboxylic acid. That seems like product (alkene). The template would break the C-P bond (phosphonate) and C-O bond (maybe from phosphonate) to form the alkene. The product does not contain phosphorus. So the product SMILES does not have P. Indeed none of these SMILES have P. So they are product. Good.

Thus the target molecule SMILES is that complex alkene. Let's pick the first one as target. Use that in search.

Now call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_broken maybe ["phosphonate"]? Not sure list. Let's get available functional groups to see naming.


We need to call get_available_functional_groups to see naming.
